Materials science and technology are our passion. With our cutting-edge research, Empa’s approximately 1,100 employees make decisive contributions to the benefit of society for a future worth living in. Empa is a research institution of the ETH Domain.

Research engineer in mechatronics for biomedical sensor systems (a)

In the Digital Health Solutions research area, we develop technologies for the continuous monitoring of body signals that are flexibly tailored to different applications – from medical patient monitoring to occupational safety in demanding environments to top-level sports.

In the Biomimetic Membranes and Textiles laboratory, an interdisciplinary team is working on innovative, multimodal sensor systems, especially in combination with textile solutions. Our sensor concepts are developed, examined and validated under realistic conditions. We analyse measurement accuracy, robustness and long-term stability. In addition to wear tests, we use standardized measuring setups that enable controlled and reproducible tests. We are also currently developing a platform for the realistic simulation of (patho-)physiological body signals.

Their tasks

• They develop and implement a mechatronic system for simulating various body signals (e.g. ECG; blood pressure, pulse wave, oxygen saturation, respiration), including the integration of hardware and software components.

• They plan and perform experimental validation and verification measurements.

• They create technical documentation (e.g. standard operating procedures) and ensure the quality of the developed systems.

• They support the research team in the evaluation of sensor systems for detecting body signals.

• They take over the management of sub-projects and coordinate development tasks as well as cooperation with internal and external partners.

• They participate in the technical development of project proposals as well as in the presentation and further development of system solutions in laboratory operations.

Your profile

• Master’s or PhD degree in Biomedical Engineering, Robotics, or a related discipline with relevant practical experience.

• In-depth technical knowledge in mechanical and electrical systems as well as in the development and application of control units.

• Experience in simulation, data acquisition, processing and signal quality analysis.

• Basic understanding of physiological signals and interest in biomedical applications.

• Experience in (sub)project management as well as structured, independent working methods.

• Proactive, solution-oriented personality with quick comprehension and very good knowledge of German and English.

Our offer

We offer you the opportunity to contribute and further develop your expertise in an application-oriented and innovative research environment. They work in interdisciplinary teams and cooperate with national and international partners from research and industry. In this way, you not only expand your professional know-how, but also your personal network and create an excellent basis for your further career in research and development.

Empa actively supports you in your professional and personal development and offers an inspiring, collaborative working environment. The job starts by agreement, the job is initially limited to three years. In the case of positive project development and mutual interest, there is the prospect of continued employment.

“a” stands for “all” in our job advertisements. We live a culture of inclusion and respect. We welcome all people who are in the mood for innovative, sustainable and meaningful activities - only that counts.

We look forward to your complete online application incl. Letter of motivation, CV, certificates, diplomas and contact details of two reference persons. Please submit them exclusively via our application portal. Applications by e-mail or by post will not be considered.

jobs.title: PhD Position on All-Solid-State Batteries

titleByLocale.en: PhD Position on All-Solid-State Batteries
titleByLocale.it: Posizione di dottorato su batterie interamente a stato solido
titleByLocale.fr: Position du Ph.D. sur les batteries tout État

jobs.description:
Materials science and technology are our passion. With our cutting-edge research, Empa's around 1,100 employees make essential contributions to the well-being of society for a future worth living. Empa is a research institution of the ETH Domain.

PhD Position on All-Solid-State Batteries

Empa’s Laboratory Materials for Energy Conversion focuses on materials and device innovation for sustainable energy technologies.

Your tasks

The aim of this PhD project is to investigate lithium- and sodium-based solid-state batteries using muon-based bulk and interface characterization techniques. The main objective is to gain a mechanistic understanding of electrochemical performance, with a focus on ion distribution, transport, and degradation processes during battery operation.
 The project addresses key questions such as the formation of Li/Na concentration gradients during charge and discharge, the evolution of interphases, and degradation mechanisms including ageing, material dissolution (leaching), and transition-metal migration. Muon-based methods will be used to probe depth-resolved properties that are difficult to access with conventional techniques, enabling new insights into buried interfaces and bulk transport phenomena.

Your work will focus on electrochemical and structural characterization of battery materials and cells, combined with muon-based experiments. You will design and carry out experiments to identify reaction pathways and degradation mechanisms, and analyze complex datasets to connect microscopic processes with macroscopic performance. Close collaboration with project partners will support the development and testing of materials and cell concepts.

Your profile

You hold a Master’s degree in chemistry, materials science, or a related field, experience in electrochemistry or batteries is an advantage. Excellent English skills are required.

Our offer

You will conduct your research in Empa’s laboratories in Dübendorf and will be enrolled in the doctoral program in Electrical Engineering at ETH Zurich. The project is part of the National Centre of Competence in Research (NCCR) Muoniverse and is funded by the Swiss National Science Foundation.
 Muoniverse connects over 30 research groups and offers a structured research school with training, exchange opportunities, and career development. We are looking for candidates who enjoy collaborative, interdisciplinary research and value openness and shared progress. Muoniverse is committed to equal opportunities, diversity, and an inclusive research culture.

You will independently conduct experiments, including muon beamline studies, collaborate with academic and industrial partners, and disseminate your results through publications and presentations. Our laboratories provide access to a broad range of battery research infrastructure, including gloveboxes, furnaces, spectroscopy, microscopy, and extensive electrochemical testing facilities.

Start date is October 1st, 2026 or upon agreement.

Empa is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We strongly encourage applications from female researchers and individuals from underrepresented backgrounds. We believe diversity drives innovation and scientific excellence. Join us in contributing to groundbreaking research in sustainable energy technologies!

We look forward to receiving your online application including a two-page motivation letter, CV, scholarly records, diplomas with transcripts, and at least two reference letters. Only complete applications will be considered. Please upload all documents through our webpage, applications via E-mail cannot be accepted.

We believe diversity drives innovation and scientific excellence. Join us in contributing to groundbreaking research in sustainable energy technologies!

We look forward to receiving your online application including a two-page motivation letter, CV, scholarly records, diplomas with transcripts, and at least two reference letters. Only complete applications will be considered. Please upload all documents through our webpage, applications via E-mail cannot be accepted.
descriptionByLocale.it:
La scienza dei materiali e la tecnologia sono la nostra passione. Con la nostra ricerca all'avanguardia, i circa 1.100 dipendenti di Empa danno un contributo essenziale al benessere della società per un futuro che vale la pena di vivere. Empa è un'istituzione di ricerca del dominio ETH.

PhD Position sulle batterie All-Solid-State

I materiali di laboratorio di Empa per la conversione dell'energia si concentrano sull'innovazione dei materiali e dei dispositivi per le tecnologie energetiche sostenibili.

I tuoi compiti

L'obiettivo di questo progetto PhD è quello di indagare le batterie allo stato solido a base di litio e di sodio utilizzando le tecniche di caratterizzazione di massa e interfaccia a base di muon. L'obiettivo principale è quello di ottenere una comprensione meccanicistica delle prestazioni elettrochimiche, con un focus sui processi di distribuzione, trasporto e degrado dell'ione durante il funzionamento della batteria.
 Il progetto affronta questioni chiave come la formazione di gradienti di concentrazione di Li/Na durante la carica e lo scarico, l'evoluzione delle interfase e dei meccanismi di degrado tra cui l'invecchiamento, la dissoluzione materiale (leaching), e la migrazione di transizione-metal. I metodi a base di muon saranno utilizzati per sondare le proprietà recuperate in profondità che sono difficili da accedere alle tecniche convenzionali, consentendo nuove intuizioni nelle interfacce sepolte e nei fenomeni di trasporto in massa.

Il vostro lavoro si concentrerà sulla caratterizzazione elettrochimica e strutturale dei materiali e delle cellule della batteria, combinati con esperimenti basati su muon. Progetterai e eseguirai esperimenti per identificare le vie di reazione e i meccanismi di degradazione, e analizzerai set di dati complessi per collegare i processi microscopici con prestazioni macroscopiche. Una stretta collaborazione con i partner del progetto sosterrà lo sviluppo e la sperimentazione di materiali e concetti cellulari.

Il tuo profilo

Hai un Master in chimica, scienza dei materiali, o un campo correlato, l'esperienza in elettrochimica o batterie è un vantaggio. Sono richieste eccellenti competenze in inglese.

La nostra offerta

Potrai condurre la tua ricerca nei laboratori di Empa a Dübendorf e sarà iscritto nel programma di dottorato in Ingegneria Elettrica presso ETH Zurich. Il progetto fa parte del National Centre of Competence in Research (NCCR) Muoniverse ed è finanziato dalla Swiss National Science Foundation.
 Muoniverse collega oltre 30 gruppi di ricerca e offre una scuola di ricerca strutturata con formazione, opportunità di scambio e sviluppo di carriera. Siamo alla ricerca di candidati che amano la ricerca collaborativa, interdisciplinare e l'apertura del valore e il progresso condiviso. Muoniverse si impegna a pari opportunità, diversità e una cultura della ricerca inclusiva.

Potrai condurre in modo indipendente esperimenti, tra cui studi di teletrasporto, collaborare con partner accademici e industriali, e diffondere i risultati attraverso pubblicazioni e presentazioni. I nostri laboratori forniscono l'accesso a una vasta gamma di infrastrutture di ricerca della batteria, tra cui glovebox, forni, spettroscopia, microscopia e impianti di test elettrochimici.

La data di inizio è il 1 ottobre 2026 o su accordo.

Empa si impegna per la diversità, l'equità e l'inclusione. Noi incoraggiamo fortemente le applicazioni da ricercatori e individui femminili da backgrounds sottorappresentati. Crediamo che la diversità spinga l'innovazione e l'eccellenza scientifica. Unisciti a noi per contribuire alla ricerca innovativa nelle tecnologie energetiche sostenibili!

Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la vostra domanda online tra cui una lettera di motivazione di due pagine, CV, record di studiosi, diplomi con trascrizioni, e almeno due lettere di riferimento. Saranno considerate solo le applicazioni complete. Si prega di caricare tutti i documenti attraverso la nostra pagina web, le applicazioni via E-mail non possono essere accettate.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Materialwissenschaft und -technologie sind unsere Leidenschaft. Mit unserer Spitzenforschung leisten die rund 1.100 Mitarbeiter der Empa wesentliche Beiträge zum Wohl der Gesellschaft für eine lebenswerte Zukunft. Die Empa ist eine Forschungseinrichtung des ETH-Bereichs.

PhD-Position zu All-Solid-State-Batterien

Der Fokus von Empa Labormaterialien für Energieumwandlung liegt auf Material- und Geräteinnovationen für nachhaltige Energietechnologien.

Ihre Aufgaben

Ziel dieses PhD-Projekts ist es, Lithium- und Natrium-basierte Festkörperbatterien unter Verwendung von Myonen-basierten Bulk- und Interface-Charakterisierungstechniken zu untersuchen. Das Hauptziel besteht darin, ein mechanistisches Verständnis der elektrochemischen Leistung zu erlangen, wobei der Schwerpunkt auf Ionenverteilung, -transport und -abbauprozessen während des Batteriebetriebs liegt.
 Das Projekt befasst sich mit Schlüsselfragen wie der Bildung von Li/Na-Konzentrationsgradienten während Ladung und Entladung, der Entwicklung von Interphasen und Abbaumechanismen einschließlich Alterung, Materialauflösung (Auslaugung) und Übergangsmetallmigration. Muon-basierte Methoden werden verwendet, um tief aufgelöste Eigenschaften zu untersuchen, die mit herkömmlichen Techniken schwer zugänglich sind, was neue Einblicke in vergrabene Schnittstellen und Massentransportphänomene ermöglicht.

Ihre Arbeit konzentriert sich auf die elektrochemische und strukturelle Charakterisierung von Batteriematerialien und -zellen, kombiniert mit myonenbasierten Experimenten. Sie entwerfen und führen Experimente durch, um Reaktionswege und Abbaumechanismen zu identifizieren, und analysieren komplexe Datensätze, um mikroskopische Prozesse mit makroskopischer Leistung zu verbinden. Eine enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Projektpartnern wird die Entwicklung und Erprobung von Materialien und Zellkonzepten unterstützen.

Dein Profil

Sie haben einen Master-Abschluss in Chemie, Materialwissenschaften oder einem verwandten Bereich, Erfahrung in der Elektrochemie oder Batterien ist ein Vorteil. Hervorragende Englischkenntnisse sind erforderlich.

Unser Angebot

Sie forschen in den Empa-Laboratorien in Dübendorf und werden im Promotionsprogramm Elektrotechnik an der ETH Zürich eingeschrieben. Das Projekt ist Teil des National Centre of Competence in Research (NCCR) Muoniverse und wird vom Schweizerischen Nationalfonds gefördert.
 Muoniverse verbindet über 30 Forschungsgruppen und bietet eine strukturierte Forschungsschule mit Ausbildung, Austauschmöglichkeiten und Karriereentwicklung. Wir suchen Kandidaten, die kooperative, interdisziplinäre Forschung genießen und Wert auf Offenheit und gemeinsamen Fortschritt legen. Muoniverse setzt sich für Chancengleichheit, Vielfalt und eine inklusive Forschungskultur ein.

Sie führen unabhängig Experimente durch, einschließlich Myon-Beamline-Studien, arbeiten mit akademischen und industriellen Partnern zusammen und verbreiten Ihre Ergebnisse durch Publikationen und Präsentationen. Unsere Labore bieten Zugang zu einer breiten Palette von Batterieforschungsinfrastrukturen, darunter Gloveboxen, Öfen, Spektroskopie, Mikroskopie und umfangreiche elektrochemische Prüfeinrichtungen.

Startdatum ist der 1. Oktober 2026 oder nach Vereinbarung.

Die Empa setzt sich für Diversität, Gerechtigkeit und Inklusion ein. Wir empfehlen nachdrücklich Bewerbungen von Forscherinnen und Einzelpersonen mit unterrepräsentiertem Hintergrund. Wir glauben, dass Vielfalt Innovation und wissenschaftliche Exzellenz vorantreibt. Tragen Sie mit uns zu einer bahnbrechenden Forschung im Bereich nachhaltiger Energietechnologien bei!

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Online-Bewerbung mit einem zweiseitigen Motivationsschreiben, Lebenslauf, wissenschaftlichen Aufzeichnungen, Diplomen mit Transkripten und mindestens zwei Referenzschreiben. Es werden nur vollständige Anträge berücksichtigt. Bitte laden Sie alle Dokumente über unsere Webseite hoch, Bewerbungen per E-Mail können nicht angenommen werden.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
La science et la technologie des matériaux sont notre passion. Grâce à nos recherches de pointe, les quelque 1 100 employés d'Empa apportent une contribution essentielle au bien-être de la société pour un avenir digne d'être vécu. Empa est une institution de recherche du domaine ETH.

Position du Ph.D. sur les batteries tout État

Les matériaux de laboratoire pour la conversion de l'énergie sont axés sur l'innovation des matériaux et des appareils pour les technologies énergétiques durables.

Vos tâches

Le but de ce projet de doctorat est d'étudier les batteries à l'état solide à base de lithium et de sodium à l'aide de techniques de caractérisation en vrac et d'interface à base de muon. L'objectif principal est d'acquérir une compréhension mécaniste de la performance électrochimique, en mettant l'accent sur la distribution des ions, le transport et les processus de dégradation pendant le fonctionnement de la batterie.
 Le projet aborde des questions clés telles que la formation de gradients de concentration de Li/Na pendant la charge et le rejet, l'évolution des interphases et les mécanismes de dégradation, y compris le vieillissement, la dissolution des matériaux (délavage) et la migration des métaux de transition. Des méthodes basées sur le muon seront utilisées pour sonder les propriétés résolues en profondeur qui sont difficiles d'accès avec les techniques conventionnelles, ce qui permettra de découvrir de nouvelles interfaces enfouies et des phénomènes de transport en vrac.

Votre travail se concentrera sur la caractérisation électrochimique et structurelle des matériaux et des cellules de la batterie, combinée à des expériences basées sur le muon. Vous concevrez et réaliserez des expériences pour identifier les voies de réaction et les mécanismes de dégradation, et analyserez des ensembles de données complexes pour relier les processus microscopiques aux performances macroscopiques. Une collaboration étroite avec les partenaires du projet appuiera l'élaboration et l'essai de matériaux et de concepts cellulaires.

Votre profil

Vous êtes titulaire d'un Master en chimie, science des matériaux ou un domaine connexe, expérience en électrochimie ou batteries est un avantage. D'excellentes compétences en anglais sont requises.

Notre offre

Vous effectuerez vos recherches dans les laboratoires d'Empa's à Dübendorf et serez inscrit au programme de doctorat en génie électrique à l'ETH Zurich. Le projet fait partie du Centre national de compétence en recherche (NCCR) Muoniverse et est financé par la Fondation nationale suisse des sciences.
 Muoniverse relie plus de 30 groupes de recherche et offre une école de recherche structurée avec des possibilités de formation, d'échange et de développement de carrière. Nous recherchons des candidats qui apprécient la recherche collaborative, interdisciplinaire et valorisent l'ouverture et le progrès partagé. Muoniverse est attachée à l'égalité des chances, à la diversité et à une culture de la recherche inclusive.

Vous réaliserez des expériences indépendantes, y compris des études en faisceaux muon, collaborerez avec des partenaires académiques et industriels, et diffuserez vos résultats au moyen de publications et de présentations. Nos laboratoires offrent un large éventail d'infrastructures de recherche sur les piles, notamment des boîtes à gants, des fours, de la spectroscopie, de la microscopie et de vastes installations d'essais électrochimiques.

La date de début est le 1er octobre 2026 ou sur accord.

Empa est attachée à la diversité, à l'équité et à l'inclusion. Nous encourageons fortement les candidatures de femmes chercheurs et de personnes issues de milieux sous-représentés. Nous croyons que la diversité stimule l'innovation et l'excellence scientifique. Rejoignez-nous pour contribuer à la recherche révolutionnaire sur les technologies énergétiques durables!

Nous sommes impatients de recevoir votre demande en ligne, y compris une lettre de motivation de deux pages, un CV, des documents scientifiques, des diplômes avec transcriptions et au moins deux lettres de référence. Seules les demandes complètes seront examinées. Veuillez télécharger tous les documents via notre page Web, les applications par e-mail ne peuvent pas être acceptées.
